CI Bot: Pipeline main #19537 failed after merge (PR 5587). Failing job: e2e-linux-serial. Logs: `TimeoutError: KV cache test timed out after 120s`. See https://ci.redwood.example/runs/19537 :rotating_light:
maya: Ugh — that PR just merged. @oleg can you check? quick triage pls.
vikram: @maya paging infra team, looks like the failure is in `test_token_cache` on the persistence runner. Could be a resource flake.
oleg: On it. I saw one timeout in my local run but assumed noisy infra. Reproducing now.
linh: If it's flaky we should rerun before reverting — low impact if it's transient. `ci rerun job 19537 --stage e2e-linux-serial`
CI Bot: Rerun started by linh (job 19537.2).
sre-bot: FYI there's a node oom spike on build-agent-37 around the time of the failure: `kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 12345 (python)` — attaching metrics.
maya: Ok that points to infra noise. But still want to be safe — @oleg can you bisect between HEAD and origin/main~8 to see if PR 5587 introduced flakiness?
oleg: Running a quick bisect now: `git bisect start --term-old=good --term-new=bad origin/main~8 HEAD` then `./scripts/ci/run-e2e --target test_token_cache`
vikram: If bisect is slow, consider a narrow revert of the PR as a precaution toggle for the canary traffic (we're in prod?).
oleg: Bisect found 1 suspect commit (commit 9fd3c2) touching kv cache eviction heuristics — that's in PR 5587. I'll open a follow-up patch to revert the heuristic change and run tests.
CI Bot: Rerun (19537.2) completed — same test failed, consistent with bisect.
maya: Thanks. @sre-bot can you schedule a temporary capacity increase on agents in region-us-west for the next 30m to reduce noise while we validate?
sre-bot: Scheduled +10 agents in region-us-west until 1743859900.
linh: Oleg, if revert is straightforward, let's merge the revert to unblock main and then iterate on the heuristic in a branch with more coverage.
oleg: Will open revert PR in a minute and ping for review.
maya: Perfect. Thanks everyone — please paste the revert PR link here when ready and mark if we should ship a hotfix. :white_check_mark:
